In most situations, soldiers did not have cameras with them, which means that many events were never recorded. The same applies to many weapons, military vehicles, and wartime technologies. Since only limited footage exists, we use illustrations, animations, and visual reconstructions to tell the complete story, from development and production to their role on the battlefield.

Канал посвящен подбору доступных городов Бразилии для переезда на пенсию, ориентируясь на бюджет в одну минимальную зарплату. Автор детально разбирает стоимость аренды, безопасность и качество жизни в разных регионах, от побережья до сельской местности. Примеры тем: «Лучший пляжный город для жизни на 1 зарплату», «10 городов с дешевыми фермами в Минас-Жерайс». Видео на португальском языке, длительностью 15–30 минут, без лица. channels.title: Wade Colter
channels.description:
My name's Wade Colter.

I'm sixty-four years old, fourth generation on the same ground in the Rolling Plains of West Texas. My people came up the trail in 1878 and never left. I learned this trade from men who were finishing their working lives when I was starting mine, and most of what they taught me was never written down anywhere.

This channel is where I put it down before it goes quiet.

Heat, cold, water, fire, food, sleep, pain, and the small daily problems every man used to know how to solve for himself.

- Wade

channels.title: Matricule 001
channels.description:
Tu commences sans rien. Même pas un nom.

Chaque vidéo, tu entres tout en bas d'une hiérarchie fermée — une armée, un ordre, un cartel, un empire — et tu la montes grade par grade jusqu'au sommet. Dix échelons. Une vie entière en quinze minutes.

À chaque grade, on te donne quelque chose : un lit, un galon, une arme, un appartement, une voiture, une villa. Et à chaque grade, on te ferme une porte. Au sommet, il n'y a jamais ce qu'on t'avait promis.

Armées, sectes, cartels, polices politiques, cours royales, ordres secrets, grandes institutions. Toutes les époques, tous les pays. Un seul point commun : on n'en sort pas.

Une nouvelle vie tous les deux jours.
Jusqu'à quel grade serais-tu monté ?

channels.title: Biblijne Opowieści
channels.description:
✨ Witamy na kanale Biblijne Opowieści ✨

Ten kanał poświęcony jest odkrywaniu piękna Pisma Świętego poprzez biblijne opowieści, refleksje nad nauczaniem Jezusa Chrystusa, historię chrześcijaństwa oraz duchową mądrość przedstawioną w przystępny i inspirujący sposób.

Dzięki filmowej narracji oraz wizualizacjom wspomaganym przez sztuczną inteligencję każdy materiał zachęca do głębszego poznawania Biblii, umacniania wiary i odkrywania ponadczasowego przesłania Słowa Bożego.

Niezależnie od tego, czy dopiero rozpoczynasz swoją drogę z Biblią, czy zgłębiasz ją od wielu lat, zapraszamy Cię do wspólnego odkrywania jej niezwykłego bogactwa.

ZASTRZEŻENIE:
Treści publikowane na tym kanale mają charakter edukacyjny i inspiracyjny. Przedstawione interpretacje oraz komentarze służą pogłębianiu wiedzy biblijnej i mogą różnić się w zależności od tradycji chrześcijańskich. Zachęcamy widzów do osobistej lektury Pisma Świętego oraz dalszego zgłębiania jego nauczania.

📜 What we investigate:
• Direct quotes and parallels between the Apostles and ancient scrolls.
• Historical context of the Second Temple period.
• Uncovering what the earliest readers knew that modern readers missed.

channels.title: Lost Everyday Britain
channels.description:
Welcome to Lost Everyday Britain, a channel about ordinary life in 1950s and 1960s Britain and the world that quietly slipped away.

Each documentary looks at the jobs people did, the shops they used and the towns they called home. We tell the stories of vanished trades such as the milkman, the bus conductor, the rag-and-bone man and the cinema usherette. We walk down the old British high street, past the corner shop, the ironmonger, the haberdasher and the chain stores that have gone. We visit market towns, seaside resorts, mill towns and railway towns, and see how they changed.

This is British social history told calmly and honestly: how families worked, shopped and lived after the war, why that way of life disappeared, and what remains today.

If you grew up in the 1950s or 1960s, or simply enjoy British nostalgia and well-researched history documentaries, you are very welcome here.

New films regularly. Please subscribe and share your own memories in the comments.

channels.description:
Советы из СССР — канал о забытых хитростях, привычках и быте, которые раньше знали в каждой семье.
Здесь мы вспоминаем, как жили обычные люди: советские советы и хозяйские хитрости, экономию и бережливость, забытые рецепты и еду из простых продуктов, дачные секреты, старый быт и житейскую смекалку, которая помогала справляться с дефицитом, очередями и трудными временами.

Мы не собираем случайные советы из интернета. Каждое видео делается как отдельная история: с поиском деталей, понятным сценарием, спокойным рассказом и уважением к эпохе и к людям, которые в ней жили. Без политики и споров — только вещи, кухня, дом и память.
Многое из этого сегодня кажется странным. А потом смотришь на чек в магазине — и понимаешь, что наши бабушки знали что-то важное.

Если вам близки советские хитрости, забытый быт и настоящая житейская мудрость — подписывайтесь и пишите в комментариях, что помните сами. Часто самые интересные истории оказываются именно там.

channels.title: Baldy POV
channels.description:
Baldy POV puts you inside one man's life, in a world most people never get to see: a 911 dispatch room, the Vatican, Special Forces, the year after a lottery win.

Sometimes it's a climb through every rank of a real job. Sometimes it's a fall from the top, piece by piece. Sometimes it's one night where everything goes wrong, or years of a life changing in ways nobody planned.

The man is invented. His world is not. You come away knowing who holds the power, how the money moves and what each step costs. We check the facts before a video is made.

Each story is built around one thing we think is true about that life, so each gets its own turning point and its own ending. We pick every world, listen to every line and look at every picture ourselves.

Every story signs off the same way, the cycle continues, but no two get there by the same road.

What world do you want to see from the inside? Tell us in the comments.

Видео на хинди, длинные выпуски по 20–30 минут, без лица, монетизация через рекламу и прямые контакты.

channels.title: Ingeniería al Extremo
channels.description:
Bienvenido a Ingeniería al Extremo.

Aquí desmontamos las hazañas de la ingeniería humana llevadas a su límite: puentes que desafían la física, túneles bajo montañas enteras, máquinas de guerra, cohetes, presas capaces de contener océanos enteros.

Cada vídeo entra en el proyecto pieza por pieza. Cómo se diseñó. Qué falló durante la construcción. Qué estuvo a punto de derrumbarlo todo, y cómo se resolvió.

Veinte años de trabajo no caben en un resumen de tres minutos, así que aquí tampoco caben. Cada historia se cuenta con el mismo rigor que exigió construir lo que cuenta.

Cómo aguanta un rascacielos un terremoto de magnitud ocho. Por qué un submarino nuclear pasa meses bajo el agua sin salir a respirar. Esto es lo que exploramos, semana tras semana.

Suscríbete si el ingenio humano al límite te interesa tanto como a nosotros.

channels.title: Earth Circuit
channels.description:
The best solutions to modern problems already exist. Most of them are just forgotten.
At Earth Circuit, we research the passive, low-tech, and material-based technologies that once kept cities cool, homes warm, and families fed — without electricity, without subscriptions, and without a monthly bill. We trace the science, follow the history, and ask the question the industry would rather you didn't: why did we stop?
Every video is thoroughly researched before we publish. We use real physics, real historical records, and real field data. We are honest about what works, where it works, and what it won't do. We are not perfect, and we will tell you when something is uncertain.
We cover passive cooling, off-grid energy, atmospheric water harvesting, thermal mass construction, and the forgotten engineering principles that modern building codes have quietly made illegal. If you believe the simplest solution is usually the right one, you are in the right place.

The Origin Atlas investigates where the world's peoples actually came from — using ancient DNA studies, peer-reviewed archaeogenetic research, and findings from the fossil record to challenge what history textbooks assumed was settled.

New videos posted every 2–3 days.

Houses for Nothing explores the forgotten corners of America where homes cost less than a used car — and asks the question everyone's thinking: what's the catch?

Every week, we travel through empty states, dying small towns, and real ghost towns where houses sell for $2,000, $5,000, or $10,000 — and somehow, nobody wants them. From abandoned coal towns in Appalachia to empty farm communities in the Midwest, from desert ghost towns to fading main streets, we uncover the real stories behind America's cheapest real estate: why these places emptied out, what life is still like there, and what you'd actually be getting into if you bought one of these dirt-cheap homes.

If you've ever scrolled through Zillow at 2am wondering how a 3-bedroom house can cost $4,000 — this channel is for you.

New videos every week. Subscribe and find out what nothing really buys.

channels.notes_ru:
Канал посвящен подборкам загадочных мест на планете, нераскрытым тайнам истории и мистическим явлениям. Примеры тем: «10 таинственных мест, в существование которых вы не поверите» и «Таинственные огни долины Хессдален в Норвегии». Ролики выходят на тайском языке, длительностью от 10 до 44 минут, в закадровом формате без присутствия автора.

Видеоряд на 80% состоит из сгенерированных нейросетями видеофрагментов и концепт-артов с добавляемой графикой и картами, а также стоковых видеофайлов (~20%). Сопровождается закадровой озвучкой.

Классифицировано 06.11 (Gemini): просмотр 2 мин ролика «10 สถานที่ที่คุณจะไม่เชื่อว่า ‘มีอยู่จริง’ จนได้เห็นด้วยตา».

No gadgets. No gear. Just the old way, done every week, by somebody who still lives it.

Come sit on the porch a while. New video every week.

channels.description:
중고차와 국산차를 가격·연비·승차감·감가로 줄 세워 보여주는 채널입니다. 500만원부터 3000만원까지, 첫차 추천부터 안 팔리는 차까지, SUV·세단·하이브리드·전기차를 취향이 아니라 숫자로 이야기합니다.

중고차 도서관은 한국에서 팔리는 자동차를 '자료'로 정리합니다. 경차·소형차·세단·SUV·미니밴·픽업, 국산차와 수입차, 가솔린·디젤·하이브리드·전기차까지 차종을 가리지 않습니다.

【다루는 것】
· 중고차 추천 — 500만원 / 1000만원 / 1500만원 / 2000만원 / 3000만원 가격대별
· 국산차 순위 — 가격 순위, 연비 순위, 승차감 순위, 제로백 순위, 판매량 순위
· 첫차 추천, 사회초년생과 출퇴근용 가성비 차
· 중고 SUV, 중고 하이브리드, 중고 전기차, 수입 중고차
· 감가가 심한 차와 잔존가치가 버티는 차
· 안 팔리는 차 — 왜 안 팔렸고, 그래서 지금 싼가
· 주행거리(키로수)와 연식, 어디까지 괜찮은가
· 무사고와 침수차 구별, 중고차 사기 유형과 피하는 법
· 유지비, 보험료, 부품값까지 포함한 진짜 가격

【원칙】
순위는 가격, 판매대수, 연비, 감가율로 매깁니다. 출처는 영상 안에 표시합니다.
얼굴도 광고도 없습니다. 차 이야기만 합니다.

보고 싶은 차종은 댓글로 남겨주세요.

channels.title: Gloria's Kitchen Table
channels.description:
I'm Gloria. I'm seventy-five years old, and everything I know about a stove I learned standing at
my mother's elbow.

She fed nine people on eight dollars a week and never wrote down a single line of it. She thought
there'd be time. She died on a Tuesday and I stood in her kitchen afterwards and couldn't find
one recipe in her handwriting.

So this table is where I say it out loud before it goes. Every day I sit down and go back into
those kitchens — the suppers, the Sunday dishes, the foil pans that went to church, the fish fry
on a Friday — and I name the food our mothers and grandmothers made, and what it felt like to eat
it.

I'm not a chef. I have no license and no restaurant. I'm a woman who was there.

The recipes are written out complete in my cookbook, in large print:
honestvoicesbooks.com

New memories every day.

Somebody fed you. Say her name.

Bienvenido a Jardín Productivo, un canal dedicado a la jardinería práctica, el huerto urbano y el cultivo de alimentos en espacios pequeños.

Aquí aprenderás cómo cultivar verduras, hortalizas, hierbas aromáticas, frutas y plantas útiles en macetas, balcones, terrazas, patios, ventanas e incluso en agua. Nuestro objetivo es ayudarte a crear un huerto en casa más productivo, fácil y sostenible, aunque tengas poco espacio, poca experiencia o poco tiempo.

Compartimos ideas de cultivo en macetas, plantas fáciles para principiantes, trucos de jardinería, consejos para mejorar la cosecha, plantas que crecen en sombra, cultivos de bajo mantenimiento y formas simples de tener alimentos frescos cerca de tu cocina.

Si sueñas con cosechar más en menos espacio, ahorrar dinero, reconectar con la naturaleza y transformar tu hogar en un pequeño jardín productivo, este canal es para ti.

Suscríbete y empieza hoy a cultivar tu propio huerto en casa.

channels.title: El Huerto de Don Ernesto
channels.description:
Bienvenido a El Huerto de Don Ernesto, un espacio para aprender a cultivar tus propios alimentos en casa de forma sencilla, práctica y realista.

Soy Ernesto Ramírez, aunque puedes llamarme Don Ernesto. Aquí aprenderemos juntos a cultivar jitomates, chiles, hierbas, frutas y hortalizas aprovechando el espacio que ya tienes: un patio, una azotea, un balcón o unas cuantas macetas.

Encontrarás métodos paso a paso, ideas para reutilizar materiales, consejos para cuidar tus plantas, evitar errores comunes y conseguir mejores cosechas sin complicarte.

No necesitas un gran terreno ni ser un experto para comenzar. Una maceta, un poco de espacio y saber qué hacer en el momento adecuado pueden ser suficientes.

Cultivo en casa • Huertos urbanos • Reciclaje • Macetas • Frutas y hortalizas

Ponte cómodo. Aquí siempre habrá algo nuevo por sembrar, cuidar y cosechar.

Fin del Mapa es un canal documental en español sobre lugares extremos, islas remotas, territorios abandonados, naufragios, pueblos olvidados y expediciones que terminaron lejos de todo.

Contamos historias reales marcadas por el aislamiento, la supervivencia, la geografía y el abandono: personas olvidadas en islas perdidas, comunidades que desaparecieron, desastres silenciados, colonias fallidas y rincones del mundo donde la naturaleza y el tiempo borraron casi todas las huellas.

Cada documental busca responder una pregunta: ¿qué ocurre cuando un lugar queda tan lejos, tan aislado o tan olvidado que el mundo deja de mirar?

Fin del Mapa es un viaje por los límites de la civilización, la memoria y la resistencia humana.

channels.title: Ayer Vivo
channels.description:
En este canal contamos la historia de España a través de quienes la vivieron de verdad: familias, barrios y pueblos que sostuvieron el país con trabajo diario, mucho antes de que nadie hablara de desarrollismo o de progreso.

Cada video reconstruye una época concreta — la posguerra, los años del desarrollismo, la Transición — a partir de la economía doméstica real: lo que se ganaba, lo que costaba, lo que una familia podía permitirse con un solo sueldo y lo que esa vida exigía a cambio.

No buscamos nostalgia fácil. Investigamos cada dato, cada precio en pesetas, cada oficio y cada costumbre antes de contarlo, y tratamos esas vidas con el mismo respeto con el que nos gustaría que alguien contara la nuestra.

Historias para quienes quieren entender de dónde viene la España de hoy, y para quienes todavía recuerdan de dónde vino.

channels.title: Am Werkstor
channels.description:
Willkommen bei Am Werkstor.

Hier geht es um die Unternehmen, die die elektronische Welt gebaut haben – und darum, was aus ihnen geworden ist.

In jeder Folge erzählen wir die Geschichte einer einzigen Firma: wie sie entstand, wer sie aufbaute, welches Produkt alles veränderte und an welchem Punkt die Sache kippte. Dokumentarisch und ohne Eile, meist 30 Minuten.

Uns interessieren nicht nur Vorstände und Quartalszahlen, sondern vor allem die Menschen hinter den Geräten: die Ingenieure, deren Namen in keiner offiziellen Firmenchronik stehen, obwohl sie das Entscheidende gebaut haben.

Wir arbeiten mit Daten, Zahlen und nachprüfbaren Quellen. Und wenn sich eine Entscheidung auf zwei Arten lesen lässt, zeigen wir beide.

Themen: Computer und Heimcomputer, Prozessoren und Halbleiter, Telefone und Mobilfunk, gescheiterte Giganten und stille Weltmarktführer.

Für alle, die diese Geräte noch selbst benutzt haben – und für alle, die wissen wollen, warum es sie heute nicht mehr gibt.

channels.title: James J. Conner
channels.description:
Sixty years on one pit in Marshall, Texas. Fire, wood, meat, beans, and the things nobody tells you.

I'm James J. Conner. I cook on the old Highway Eighty, east of town, on a pit I welded myself in 1988. My grandmother put me on the fire when I was nine. She never taught me a recipe. She taught me wood.

Nineteen years on second shift at the tire plant, selling plates out the front yard on weekends. Forty-one pits built for other people. The shop burned in 2003 and I cooked out of a trailer nine years.

Every week, how this actually works. Brisket and ribs, and what goes beside them: beans, greens, cornbread, the pot and the fire under it. I'll tell you when I'm certain and when I'm guessing, and which tricks I don't use myself.

East Texas. Chopped beef, sauce on it, hickory and sweet gum. Sauce is not an apology.

Use a thermometer. I go by hand. You shouldn't.

The man you see and hear is generated with AI. The cooking is not. Official: here, jamesjconner.com and our Facebook page.

channels.title: Otis's Kitchen
channels.description:
My mother ran a farm kitchen outside Cedar Rapids and fed eight people a day out of it. She never owned a recipe card. Everything she knew was in her head, and when she died in 2004 most of it went into the ground with her.

I'm Otis. I spent forty years picking barns and estate auctions across the Midwest, so I know what it looks like when something valuable gets thrown out because nobody recognized it. This channel is me getting down what I can of hers before it goes the same way.

The tricks, not the recipes. Why cold hands make layers. Why the skillet has to be screaming. What a farm wife did with half a pound of sausage and eleven men at the table.

Some of it the food scientists have caught up to and explained. Some of it was just a woman with one hog, one cow and eleven miles of gravel between her and a store. And where she had the right rule for the wrong reason, I'll say so — I'd rather be useful than romantic.

New video every week.

I'm Mrs. Doris. For thirty-five years I stood behind a school lunch line in southern Ohio and fed four hundred kids a day on a dollar and five cents a tray. The shoe factory closed, the steel mill closed, and my lunch count went up - my budget never did. So I learned every trick there is: the poor man meals, the Depression-era recipes, the meat stretchers, the one-pot suppers our grandparents used to survive.

 If you are cooking for one, two or a whole crowd on a tight budget - grab a tray. You are in the right line.

Four hundred kids a day and not one of them went hungry. Neither will you....

channels.title: Susurros del Hogar
channels.description:
Bienvenido a **Susurros del Hogar**, un canal dedicado a rescatar las historias silenciosas de la vida cotidiana: los objetos olvidados, las costumbres de antes, los secretos de belleza, las tradiciones familiares y la sabiduría doméstica que acompañó a generaciones enteras.

Aquí exploramos cómo vivían las mujeres, las familias y los hogares de los años 40, 50 y 60: desde los remedios caseros y rutinas antiguas hasta los pequeños rituales de cocina, limpieza, cuidado personal y convivencia que daban forma a la vida familiar.

Nuestro propósito es mirar el pasado con emoción y estilo documental, descubriendo no solo la nostalgia de otros tiempos, sino también las lecciones que aún pueden ayudarnos a vivir con más calma, orden y sentido.

Suscríbete y acompáñanos a escuchar esos susurros que todavía viven en cada cocina, cada tocador, cada carta, cada vestido y cada rincón del hogar.

Hi, I'm Burl Sizemore.

I was born in 1954 and have spent my whole life in the same county in the mountains of eastern Kentucky. My father came home from the Pacific in 1946 to a house with no electricity, no running water and a mule in the lot. I watched all three go in a decade.

This channel is about what a man carried in his pockets and what he did with it. The knives, the stones, the small tools, and the fixes that came before you could buy another one.

I am not here to tell you the old ways were wisdom. They were what was available. When something better showed up, these were not stubborn people. But every so often they threw out a thing that was better, and nobody checked. Those are worth a look.

Everyday carry, pocket knives, hand tools, sharpening, Appalachian household objects, forgotten repairs, and life in these mountains from the 1930s to the 1960s.

channels.title: Heritage Motors
channels.description:
Welcome to Heritage Motors.

We tell the stories of forgotten machines that once moved Britain — locomotives, buses, coaches, and other historic vehicles that were abandoned, left to decay, rescued, restored, and brought back to life.

From scrapyards and forgotten depots to restoration workshops and railway tracks, we follow the remarkable journeys behind these machines.

Their stories are about more than engines and steel. They are stories of history, engineering, preservation, and the people who refused to let these machines disappear.

Forgotten. Rescued. Restored. Back in motion.

This is Heritage Motors.
